// ps denotes persistent scheduling: // page_size=64 selects shuffled storage: QH64 uses packed CSR
// page64 is kv_shuffled=1: 16-token x 16-dimension tiles in separate NoPE/RoPE planes.
// QH64 keeps the 120-byte split-K ABI; QH128 uses the dedicated 88-byte ABI.

// QH64 causal=0 is the canonical lookup; decode_flags bit1 selects either causal mode.
